snippet.title: Broadside Bets Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
In the Pirate Roguelike Deckbuilder Broadside Bets you command your pirate crew in explosive battles. Build your deck and collect powerful Booties to discover creative interactions and destroy your enemies as you navigate a branching map full of different encounters, islands and treasure. 

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4617170/Broadside_Bets/
